The Terminal List (2022)
The Terminal List (2022) is an action thriller series starring Chris Pratt as James Reece, a Navy SEAL whose life changes after a mission goes horribly wrong. When Reece returns home, he is haunted by the loss of his teammates and begins questioning what really happened during the operation.
As Reece tries to understand the events surrounding the mission, he discovers disturbing inconsistencies. The people he once trusted begin to seem connected to something much bigger, and Reece becomes determined to uncover the truth behind what happened to his team.
His search quickly turns into a dangerous pursuit of those he believes are responsible. With his military training and combat experience, Reece methodically follows the clues while facing enemies who have resources, influence, and their own reasons for keeping the truth hidden.
At the same time, the series explores the personal consequences of war. Reece isn't simply dealing with an external enemy—he is also struggling with grief, trauma, anger, and the loss of the life he thought he had after leaving the battlefield.
The deeper story focuses on loyalty, revenge, betrayal, family, sacrifice, and the psychological consequences of combat. Reece's determination is driven not only by his desire for answers but also by his belief that his fallen teammates deserve justice.
As the investigation develops, the line between carrying out a mission and pursuing personal revenge becomes increasingly complicated. The series asks how far someone might go when they believe the people responsible for destroying their life have escaped accountability.
Overall, The Terminal List combines military action with a darker mystery surrounding Reece's past and the events that changed his life. Its story is driven by his search for answers and his increasingly dangerous pursuit of the people connected to the conspiracy.
💬 If you discovered that the people responsible for your team's deaths were hiding the truth, how far would you go to uncover it?

source_details.synopsis: The Terminal List is an American action thriller television series created by David DiGilio for Amazon Prime Video. It is based on the 2018 novel of the same name by Jack Carr. The series tells the story of a Navy SEAL who seeks to avenge the murder of his family. It stars Chris Pratt, Constance Wu, Taylor Kitsch, Riley Keough, Arlo Mertz, and Jeanne Tripplehorn. The first season of The Terminal List was released on July 1, 2022. In February 2023, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on October 21, 2026.
